plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he worked as an Air Force weather observer in Nevada in the 1960s, says that someone told him tall pale beings he calls the Tall Whites came into the restroom at the weather station in the base operations building at Nellis Air Force Base. Hall says he later knew from firsthand experience that this was true, because one day his own work put him there. If true, it would mean non-human beings moved about inside a US military base.
